summary.name: BoltAI
summary.one_liner: BoltAI (Bolt AI) is a native Mac app that gives one desktop workspace for chatting with ChatGPT-style cloud models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, Azure, Bedrock) and local LLMs.
use_cases: chat with multiple AI models in one app
run local LLMs via Ollama or LM Studio
analyze PDFs and screenshots with vision models
explain or rewrite text with a global shortcut
build reusable AI agents with tools
summary.what_it_does: BoltAI is a native macOS app built with SwiftUI and AppKit that puts OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, Azure, Bedrock and local models in one workspace. It offers a global shortcut to open a pop-up over any app, plus screenshot-to-answer, dictation and inline editing. Users can organize work into projects with multi-chat threads, forking, and reusable agents, and tune generation settings such as temperature, max tokens, top-p/top-k and penalties. The app connects to local and remote MCP servers and can attach PDFs, screenshots and documents for context. The page says chats are stored locally and API keys can be encrypted with a passphrase.
notable: Native SwiftUI/AppKit Mac app optimized for Apple M-series chips
Global shortcut and Screenshot → Answer workflow
MCP server support with per-agent tool toggles
Chats synced across Mac, iPhone and iPad via cloud
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Cross-device sync depends on cloud sync; the page does not detail how it works
Max reasoning may not be supported by custom or OpenAI-compatible providers
